projects.name: / Scrum Master (SAFe) Apr 2015 – Mar 2020
details: FIS Global — Chennai, India
• Managed 2–3 Agile squads (8–10 members each) delivering digital payments and core banking features; improved
release predictability from ~60% to ~90%.
• Owned project plans, risk logs, and stakeholder communication; reported project status and escalated issues to program managers and business sponsors.
• Partnered with Architecture and DevOps teams to enable CI/CD adoption, automated testing pipelines, and faster
release cycles.
• Introduced data-driven delivery metrics (velocity trends, sprint goal success rate, defect leakage) — enabling
informed planning and stakeholder confidence.
• Facilitated structured retrospectives with measurable action items, improving team efficiency and reducing recurring
delivery issues.
